Go to the Europe returns portal: https://eur-gymshark.loopreturns.com/#/

Select the item(s) you want to return or exchange and choose the reason.
Pick a drop‑off point and either print the return label or use the QR code.
Attach the label or show the QR code when you drop the parcel off. 
Exchanges are for a different size of the same item and must be requested within 30 days of delivery.
